title: AFKDetector
description: Automatically detects AFK players and marks them in the tab list with a /afk command!
body:
AFKDetector

A lightweight plugin that **automatically** detects AFK players and marks them in the tab list!

Features
- Automatically marks players as AFK after 5 minutes of no movement
- Broadcasts a message to the server when a player goes AFK or returns
- Shows [AFK] tag next to the player's name in the tab list
- /afk command to manually toggle AFK mode
- 3 minute cooldown on the /afk command to prevent spam
- Automatically removes AFK status when the player moves

Commands
- `/afk` - Manually toggle AFK mode.

Compatibility
- Paper 26.1.2+
- Java 25+
